description.value: Ralph's Farm Market is a family-owned, year-round farm market that has been a Fraser Valley institution since 1982, growing from a seasonal hay wagon into an 11,000 square foot facility in Murrayville on Fraser Highway. The market specializes in fresh BC and Okanagan seasonal produce personally selected by the founder, alongside a full deli, in-house bakery, meat shoppe, and grocery department stocked with local, organic, vegan, and imported artisanal products. Cyclists travelling the Fraser Highway corridor will find it a well-stocked stop for fresh produce, baked goods, and a wide variety of grocery staples.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Ralph's Farm Market at 22728 Fraser Highway, Langley BC with phone (604) 532-3033, matching the OSM address. The site describes a year-round 11,000 sq ft farm market with fresh produce, deli, bakery, meat shoppe, and grocery including organic/vegan/gluten-free options, clearly supporting the Basic groceries amenity. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, ice, or any cycling-specific infrastructure anywhere on the site or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM had no phone number; phone sourced from website contact page only.
Bistro page references COVID-19 temporary closure of seating area — this content appears stale and current bistro status is unclear.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, year-round farm market on a main highway corridor with comprehensive grocery, deli, and bakery offerings — a genuinely useful resupply stop for touring cyclists even though cycling-specific amenities could not be confirmed.
